display_name: Four citations in the Minimum Wage Law, 5747-1987, and in the Minimum Wage (Working Youth and Apprentices) Regulations, 5748-1987, recorded as typed values with their tests, and one printed figure: regulation 7's citation of the repealed s 3(ג) and the definition of the average wage's citation of the 1968 National Insurance text (two defects), two sound controls, and the divisor of the hourly minimum wage (a control); not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the employee to whom the Law is applied; for the Youth and Apprentices regulations, a worker under 18 or an apprentice. The row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

read_in_place.note: read from its own subject and not copied; the revision is the one row il-43 recorded, and was not matched again here

source.note: the four texts above are unofficial consolidations; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ and official/ with their page images.

extension_order.note: the Ministry of Labour's hosted copy of the signed order on the shortening of the work week, not the Yalkut HaPirsumim publication; the day the order took effect is not established; quoted on comment lines only, with page images beside it

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of two defects, each stating what the citing words need. Regulation 7 of the Youth and Apprentices regulations cites s 3(ג) of the Law, which Sefer HaChukim 1621 p. 128, s 2(2), repealed from 1 April 1997 (s 12, p. 129). The definition of the average wage in s 1 of the Law cites the 1968 consolidated National Insurance Law, which the 1995 consolidated version replaced from 1 October 1995; the failing assertions are the LITERAL reading, that limb (a) rests on the consolidation only (CONSOLIDATION-ONLY), and the reading through s 25 of the Interpretation Law, under which the first assertion would pass, is recorded as a green test and as fork P2 in NOTES.md

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the five official pages were read by the builder
